#cloud-config
#
# ufw is deliberately NOT configured: Docker publishes container ports through iptables'
# nat table ahead of the filter chain

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true

packages:
  - curl
  - wget
  - docker.io
  - docker-buildx
  - docker-compose-v2
  - jq
  - yq

groups:
  - docker

system_info:
  default_user:
    groups: [docker]

write_files:
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      FROM python:3.13-slim
      ENV PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
          PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1 \
          PIP_ROOT_USER_ACTION=ignore
      RUN pip install ansible-core==2.21.5 \
       && ansible-galaxy collection install community.docker:==5.4.0

  - path: /opt/cirrus-ansible/ansible.cfg
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      # Settings for the controller container (ANSIBLE_CONFIG in run-ansible.sh).
      [defaults]
      inventory = /ansible/inventory.yml
      nocolor = true
      callback_result_format = yaml
      retry_files_enabled = false

  - path: /opt/cirrus-ansible/inventory.yml
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      ---
      all:
        hosts:
          vm:
            ansible_connection: community.docker.nsenter
            ansible_python_interpreter: /usr/bin/python3

  - path: /opt/cirrus-ansible/vars/vm-init-files.yml
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      ---
      vm_init_storage_account: "${ST_NAME}"
      vm_init_storage_container: "${ST_CON_NAME}"
      vm_init_subscription_id: "${SUB_ID}"
      vm_init_resource_group: "${RG_NAME}"
      vm_init_files:
        compose_file: "${compose_file}"
        acme_gts_staging: "${acme_gts_staging}"
        acme_gts: "${acme_gts}"
        acme_le_staging: "${acme_le_staging}"
        acme_le: "${acme_le}"

  # First-boot configuration of the VM. Every task runs on the host (see inventory.yml).
  - path: /opt/cirrus-ansible/site.yml
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      ---
      - name: Configure the Cirrus Docker VM
        hosts: all
        gather_facts: false
        vars_files:
          - /ansible/vars/vm-init-files.yml
        vars:
          vm_init_files_dir: /tmp/vm-init-files
          # Public-cloud blob endpoint of the init-files storage account.
          vm_init_blob_base: "https://{{ vm_init_storage_account }}.blob.core.windows.net/{{ vm_init_storage_container }}"
        tasks:
          # Token for the VM's single user-assigned identity, which IMDS serves by default (no
          # client id needed). Retried: IMDS can lag a few seconds after boot.
          - name: Get a storage access token for the VM's managed identity from IMDS
            ansible.builtin.uri:
              url: http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.azure.com%2F
              headers:
                Metadata: "true"
              return_content: true
            register: imds_token
            retries: 10
            delay: 15
            until: imds_token.status == 200
            no_log: true

          - name: Create the init files directories
            ansible.builtin.file:
              path: "{{ vm_init_files_dir }}/{{ item }}"
              state: directory
              owner: root
              group: root
              mode: "0700"
            loop: "{{ vm_init_files | dict2items | map(attribute='value') | map('dirname') | unique | list }}"

          - name: Download the init files as the VM's managed identity
            block:
              # Blob REST with the bearer token: needs only Storage Blob Data Reader on the
              # account. Retried: the identity's role assignment can take minutes to propagate
              # after a from-scratch apply. no_log keeps the Authorization header out of the
              # output; the rescue below reports what failed.
              - name: Download each init file
                ansible.builtin.get_url:
                  url: "{{ vm_init_blob_base }}/{{ item.value | urlencode }}"
                  dest: "{{ vm_init_files_dir }}/{{ item.value }}"
                  headers:
                    Authorization: "Bearer {{ imds_token.json.access_token }}"
                    x-ms-version: "2023-11-03"
                  force: true
                  owner: root
                  group: root
                  mode: "0600"
                  timeout: 60
                loop: "{{ vm_init_files | dict2items }}"
                register: vm_init_download
                retries: 20
                delay: 15
                until: vm_init_download is succeeded
                no_log: true
            rescue:
              - name: Report the failed downloads
                ansible.builtin.fail:
                  msg: >-
                    init file download failed -
                    {% for r in vm_init_download.results | default([]) if r is failed %}
                    {{ r.item.key }} ({{ r.item.value }}): {{ r.msg | default('no message') }}
                    {{ r.response | default('') }};
                    {% endfor %}

          - name: Report the downloaded init files
            ansible.builtin.debug:
              msg: "{{ item.key }}: {{ vm_init_files_dir }}/{{ item.value }}"
            loop: "{{ vm_init_files | dict2items }}"
            loop_control:
              label: "{{ item.key }}"

  - path: /opt/cirrus/bin/run-ansible.sh
    permissions: "0755"
    content: |
      #!/usr/bin/env bash
      set -euo pipefail

      dir=/opt/cirrus-ansible
      image=cirrus-ansible:local

      if ! docker image inspect "$image" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        docker build --pull -t "$image" "$dir/image"
      fi

      exec docker run --rm --name cirrus-ansible \
        --pid=host --privileged \
        -v "$dir":/ansible:ro \
        -e ANSIBLE_CONFIG=/ansible/ansible.cfg \
        "$image" ansible-playbook /ansible/site.yml "$@"

runcmd:
  # Enable docker at boot and start it now, then run the first-boot playbook.
  - systemctl enable --now docker
  - /opt/cirrus/bin/run-ansible.sh
